entity_title: Get the cédula de extranjería within 15 days
fact_text: Any foreigner holding a visa valid for more than three months must obtain a Cédula de Extranjería (foreigner ID card) from Migración Colombia within 15 calendar days of entering the country or of the visa being issued. The cédula, not the passport, is the identity document used to sign a labour contract, open a bank account and enrol in social security.
evidence_quote: El plazo máximo para solicitar la cédula de extranjería es de quince (15) días calendario, contados a partir de la fecha de ingreso al país o de la fecha de expedición de la visa, ya sea titular o beneficiario.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the visa alone is enough to live and work. Actually a separate cédula de extranjería must be requested within 15 calendar days, and missing it exposes the employee to fines and blocks payroll and banking. Action: book the Migración Colombia appointment in the first week after arrival.
